The long-drum cue borrows from the universal ancestral-rhythm tradition and the modern cultural-coded aesthetic, which is exactly why the emoji reads as rhythm-coded rather than literal percussion.

In real-world usage 🪘 lives in the spaces where the sender wants to communicate cultural-coded energy. A partner sends it on a 'feel the beat 🪘' check-in.
